FIT_EDGE_JUDGMENT_REJECTED: The model answered, but the strict judge refused the answer (not valid JSON, score or rationale).
Counted per batch; the batch fails only when more than 3 and more than 10% of its calls are refused.
FIT_EDGE_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: This job's request is over the frame limit, so it was never sent.
None; it is a fact about the job. A shortened description would clear it.
FIT_EDGE_OVERSIZE: Oracle refused the request as too large.
None for one job; three in a row with nothing judged stop the batch (a limit fault).
FIT_EDGE_ALL_TOO_LARGE: Every request in the batch was too large: the limit, not the jobs, is wrong.
Check the frame limit against Oracle's limits.
FIT_EDGE_BUSY: Oracle's model lanes are all busy.
None; the next tick asks again.
FIT_EDGE_NO_HOST: No Oracle host is configured for Cloud Fit.
Set the Edge host in the Actions secrets.
FIT_EDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Cloud Fit is not configured for this run.
FIT_EDGE_PROBE_FAILED: The pre-call probe of Oracle failed.
None; the next tick probes again.
FIT_EDGE_CONNECT_FAILED: None; the next tick retries. Persistent: check Tailscale and the Edge service.
FIT_EDGE_TIMEOUT: Oracle did not answer within the wait.
None; the row is asked again later.
FIT_EDGE_NO_REPLY: Oracle closed the connection without a reply.
FIT_EDGE_OFF_CONTRACT: Oracle's reply did not match the fit1 protocol.
Compare Oracle's service version with the repository's.
FIT_EDGE_NONCE_MISMATCH: The reply echoed a different nonce than the request carried.
Treat the reply as untrusted; check for a stale or crossed connection.
FIT_EDGE_HASH_MISMATCH: The reply's request hash did not match what was sent.
Treat the reply as untrusted; check the Edge service.
FIT_EDGE_LIMITS_OFF_CONTRACT: Oracle's reported limits are missing or not numbers.
Compare Oracle's limits answer with the protocol.
FIT_EDGE_REPLY_TOO_LARGE: Oracle's reply was over the 4 KiB reply limit.
FIT_EDGE_RECEIPT_REJECTED: The receipt (usage, model, provenance) was missing a field or invalid.
The row keeps its provenance; the field name is logged.
FIT_EDGE_PURGE_FAILED: A model ran but Oracle could not purge its session, so the batch stops after recording the row (no score).
Check Oracle's session purge before the next batch.
FIT_EDGE_REFUSED: Oracle refused the request without a known reason.
FIT_EDGE_REFUSED_QUOTA_RESERVE: The account's allowance reached Jim's reserve (stop at 50% used).
A normal stop, not a failure. It clears when the allowance resets.
FIT_EDGE_REFUSED_USAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Oracle could not read or check usage, so it made no model call.
FIT_EDGE_FIXTURE_HASH: A synthetic test fixture was modified, so it is not sent.
Restore the fixture or re-export the manifest.
FIT_EDGE_FIXTURE_MISSING: The synthetic fixture named in the test is not in the manifest.
FIT_EDGE_REPLAY_ACCEPTED: Oracle accepted a replayed nonce: its replay guard is not working.
Stop sending; fix Oracle's nonce check.
FIT_EDGE_ERROR: None; retried later. Persistent: read Oracle's service log.
FIT_EDGE_MODEL_DRIFT: Oracle used a model other than the pinned one.
Pin the model again before any more calls.
FIT_EDGE_TIMEOUT_ORPHAN: The call timed out and its model session may still be running on Oracle.
Check Oracle for an orphaned session.
MODE_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The requested Cloud Fit mode is not authorized in this run.
Authorize the mode through its switch, or run the allowed mode.
CANARY_WITHOUT_PROMOTION: A canary call was requested outside the Fit stage that owns admission.
Run the canary inside the Fit stage.
CANARY_WRITE_CONFLICT: The guarded canary write stored nothing: the row was no longer unasked.
None; an unpersisted answer is never a success.
CANARY_PROMOTION_FAILED: A canary answer is stored as this until promotion marks it CANARY.
Re-run the promotion; never leave a stuck row.
BACKLOG_TARGET_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The one named job is gone, already asked, unpublishable or excluded.
None; nothing else is asked in its place.
BACKLOG_WITHOUT_LEDGER_CHECK: A published job is asked only after its Notion page is read for human state.
Enable the ledger check for the batch.
PER_RUN_ZERO: The per-run call limit is zero.
Raise the per-run limit if calls are wanted.
PROFILE_MISSING: The Fit profile brief could not be read.
Run the profile sync; check the brief page.
PROFILE_REF_UNCONFIGURED: No profile reference is configured for Cloud Fit.
STAGE_BUDGET: No time was left for even one call in this tick.
A real shortfall; check the tick budget.
LEDGER_SYNC_INCOMPLETE: Scores are kept but the Notion ledger write-back did not finish.
BELOW_RESOLUTION: An estimate is smaller than one call's resolution, so only a bound is given.
NOT_IN_STORE: The job is not in the store.
NOT_SCORED: The job has no admission or score yet.
NO_DESCRIPTION: The job has no description to judge.
NOT_PUBLIC_POSTING: The job is not a public posting, so it is never sent to a model.
NO_SUBSTANTIVE_TEXT: The description has no real text to judge.
None; a better description would reopen it.
TITLE_LOCATION: A place name left in the title is never sent (fail closed).
NOT_ALLOWLISTED: Oracle's allowlist does not contain this caller.
NONCE_REPLAYED: Check for a crossed or retried connection.
COUNTER_UNAVAILABLE: Oracle's daily counter cannot be read, so it fails closed.
DAILY_LIMIT: Oracle's own daily call cap is reached.
A normal stop; it clears at the next daily reset.
LIMIT_UNCONFIGURED: Oracle's fail-closed daily cap has no limit.json.
Create the limit file on Oracle.
REAL_DISABLED: Real (non-synthetic) calls are switched off on Oracle.
Switch real calls on only when approved.
BRIEF_UNSAFE: The brief failed Oracle's safety check.
BRIEF_HASH_MISMATCH: The brief on Oracle is not the one the request names.
BRIEF_INVALID: The brief on Oracle is not valid.
Run the profile sync; review the brief.
PROFILE_MISMATCH: The profile on Oracle is not the one the request names.
AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: The lane's OpenAI sign-in is expired or cooling down; no model answered.
TIMEOUT_ORPHAN: Oracle status: a timed-out call may still be running.
Check Oracle for an orphaned session.
SYNC_WRITTEN: The profile block was written to Oracle.
SYNC_UNCHANGED: The profile block is already current.
SYNC_WOULD_WRITE: Dry run: a write would have happened.
SYNC_NOT_APPROVED: A write was ready but not approved.
SYNC_PAGE_UNCONFIGURED: The profile page is not configured.
SYNC_PAGE_UNREADABLE: The profile page could not be read from Notion.
SYNC_PAGE_TOO_LARGE: The profile page is over the size limit.
SYNC_NO_BLOCK: The profile page has no sync block.
SYNC_BLOCK_NOT_JSON: The sync block is not JSON.
SYNC_BLOCK_KEYS: The sync block has missing or extra keys.
SYNC_BLOCK_SIZE: The sync block is the wrong size.
SYNC_BLOCK_TOO_LARGE: The sync block is over the size limit.
SYNC_CAPABILITY_ID: The block's capability id is not the expected one.
SYNC_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The Oracle store could not be reached.
SYNC_READBACK_MISMATCH: What was written did not read back the same.
ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND: The card's anchor block was not found on the page.
CARD_AMBIGUOUS: More than one card of this kind was found.
INSTALL_FAILED: The card could not be installed.
PLACE_NOT_FOUND: No full-width divider to sit under was found, so nothing is inserted anywhere else.
RETIRE_FAILED: An old card could not be retired.
RETIRE_NOT_OWNED: The block to retire is not owned by the card.
None; the card never retires what it does not own.
ALERT_STATE_MESSAGE_REF_INVALID: The message reference is not a 64-character hash.
Pass the SHA-256 of the message id.
ALERT_STATE_NOT_READ_ONLY: The diagnostic did not get a read-only connection.
A code defect; it never writes.
PRIVATE_REPORT_NOTION_FAILED: Notion refused or did not answer the private report request.
PRIVATE_REPORT_READBACK_MISMATCH: The private report page was written but its row count did not read back.
Open the page, delete it, and repeat the run.
PRIVATE_REPORT_TOO_LARGE: The private report has more rows than one page holds.
INTERVIEW_ACTIVE: Pipeline stage word: the opportunity is in Interview.
HIRING_ACTIVE: Pipeline stage word: the opportunity is in Hiring.
FIT_GOLDEN_EMPTY: The Fit golden set is empty.
HOLD_READBACK_MISMATCH: A hold write did not read back as written.
HOLD_RETIRE_READBACK_MISMATCH: Retiring a hold did not read back as written.
NOT_PROTECTED: The job is not protected from retirement.
OFF_CONTRACT: Oracle status not on the fit1 contract; reported as FIT_EDGE_OFF_CONTRACT.

none: The job has no reason stored.
unknown: The stored reason is not one of the known words.
http_N: The job's page answered with an HTTP error (the number replaces N).
Retried by the daily slot; 403 and 429 back off.
link_mismatch: The page at the link is not this job.
Retried once with the ATS reader, then held.
no_job_id: The link names no job id, so the vacancy cannot be proven.
Retried; held if it stays unproven.
listing_url: The link is a list of jobs, not one job.
Retried; held if it stays a list.
jd_thin: The description is too short to judge.
Waits for the daily reset; a better page would clear it.
jd_template: The description is only the site's boilerplate.
jd_listing: The description is a list of other jobs.
description_empty_tf: The page and the TinyFish read both gave no description.
hold_expired: The job sat on hold past the limit and was excluded.
recovery_retry: The job was released from hold for another try.
unresolved_after_recovery: The link stayed unresolved after the recovery try.
lane_exclude: The lane policy excluded the job.
None; a policy change can requeue it.
screen_pay: The posted pay is below the floor.
in_ledger: A page for this job already exists in the Ledger.
same_opening: Another job is the same opening.
repost: The job is a repost of an earlier one.
repost_ambiguous: Two earlier jobs could be the original.
Resolve by hand if it matters.
dup_other_source: Another source already has this job.
dup_of_final_url: Another job has the same final link.
Fit_N_below_N: Fit scored the job below a floor (the numbers replace N).
audit_jd_thin: The precision audit found the description too thin.
audit_jd_template: The precision audit found only boilerplate.
audit_jd_listing: The precision audit found a list of jobs.
audit_url_listing_url: The precision audit found the link is a list of jobs.
audit_url_no_job_id: The precision audit found no job id in the link.
audit_url_root: The precision audit found the link is only a site root.
audit_url_workable_no_account: A Workable link without the account name.
no_match_ambiguous+no_fit: More than one board matched and Fit could not decide.
no_match_ambiguous+no_result: More than one board matched and the search found nothing.
no_match_no_board+no_fit: No board matched and Fit could not decide.
no_match_no_board+no_result: No board matched and the search found nothing.
no_match_no_title+no_fit: No title matched and Fit could not decide.
no_match_no_title+no_result: No title matched and the search found nothing.
excluded_fit: The precision audit excluded the job on Fit.
None; the audit can revive it.
released_keep_list: A keep-list role was released back to READY.
released_ledger: A job was released because its Ledger page is gone.
requeued_age: A stale job was requeued after its age rule changed.
requeued_direct: A job was requeued for a direct-link read.
requeued_fit: A job was requeued after Fit changed.
requeued_floor: A job was requeued after the Fit floor changed.
requeued_linkedin: A LinkedIn job was requeued for another read.
retired_by_jim: Retired by hand on Jim's instruction.
title_watch_unseen: The title watch no longer sees the role on the company's site.
route_negative: The route for this role is negative.
route_unresolved: The route for this role is unresolved.
fit_below_review_floor: Fit is below the Review floor.
fit_below_near_miss_with_open_question: Fit is a near miss with an open question.
fit_below_admit_floor: Fit is below the Admit floor, so the job is Review at best.
fit_below_admit_floor_keep_list: Fit is below the Admit floor, on the keep list.
fit_unscorable: Fit could not score the job.
thin_description: The description is too short to judge; Review from the apply link.
excluded_private_rule: A private rule excluded the job (the rule's text is never printed).
pay_below_floor: Explicit pay is below the floor.
title_only: Found by title search; the description was not read.
market_mismatch: The market is not the lane's market.
market_not_shown: The market is not shown to be the lane's market.
not_a_vacancy: Not a vacancy: an open application.
not_in_london: The role is not in London.
older_than_max_age: The posting is older than the maximum age.
posting_date_future: The posting date is in the future.
